rapport_notes: Warm, friendly tone throughout; professional pacing and attentive listening; customer comfort evident in responsive acknowledgments.
process_discipline_notes: No differentiators repeated across stages; no obvious silence violations detected on the questions asked.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: I'll just start with a few questions to get us on the right truck. This should take just a few minutes and then we'll be able to build you an accurate quote
evidence_quotes.agenda: besides pricing, do you have any questions or concerns in regards to this move that you would like answered on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer answered 'No' to the agenda question; no concerns were raised, so no follow-up layers needed or attempted.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: We do have our no worries damage coverage. Which is our free evaluation coverage included in our hourly rate provides up to $2,000 to move repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damages.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: The second is our meet your mover feature. A few days before your move, you receive a meet your mover email introducing them to you.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: we do have our online time on time guarantee we value your time. So, if we can't make it in time window that way you arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: typical move your size usually takes two movers one truck 628 hours. And since we are moving you from a fifth floor apartment with elevator access and then we're going to pack the kitchen for you... I would estimate the move to take between seven and a half and eight and a half hours
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: that's just an estimate. So you only pay for... The supplies that are used in the packing

top_strength: Brianne opened with a clear quid pro quo and asked the agenda question before any probing, establishing trust and giving the customer a chance to surface concerns upfront.
coaching_note: Communication differentiator (day-before call, named crew lead, inbox updates) was never mentioned anywhere on the call—add this to Stage 2 takeaway for future calls where the customer doesn't raise it in Stage 1; also, no explicit close ask ('Would you like our help with your move?') was made, and rate-lock messaging did not happen.
